sources.locator: Service Credits; Credit Request and Payment Procedures; Definitions
sources.rule: Regional monthly uptime threshold; Error is HTTP 500; credits 10/25/100% of affected monthly charges; greater than $1; claim required by end of second later billing cycle; future payments.
sources.contrast: Successful but cold fallback is not itself a qualifying HTTP 500; SLA eligibility is aggregate, not request-level state loss.

sources.locator: K. Remedies for breach; Service credits
sources.rule: Cloud service credits commonly offset later fees, may be capped, limited to provider-controlled failures and subject to claim deadlines; exclusive remedies can restrict customer options.
sources.contrast: Existing legal literature explicitly considers service credits. Novelty must be computational-state-specific.

sources.rule: Most organizations use prepaid credits; depleted credits block API until replenished; invoiced organizations differ.
Current Max $100 and Ultra $200 monthly API credits; Team pool capped at $500; credits expire each cycle; cover API and Managed Agents; not Claude Code or extra app usage.
sources.contrast: Managed Agents can consume included monthly credits but fallback-credit documentation explicitly excludes this surface; no guarantee that Managed Agents implements same underlying refusal paths.

scope: Separate actual contractual SLA, documented product credit, and quota accounting. No finding of breach; no observed Anthropic live transactions.
